datasets.description: ACE Mid-360 datasets used for local benchmark validation.

algorithms.name: BIEVR-LIO
algorithms.description: Robust LiDAR-inertial odometry using bump-image-enhanced voxel maps and map-informed sampling.

algorithms.name: COIN-LIO
algorithms.description: Complementary intensity-augmented LiDAR-inertial odometry for geometrically degenerate environments.

algorithms.name: CT-LIO
algorithms.description: Continuous-time LiDAR-inertial odometry combining CT-ICP constraints with a loosely coupled ESKF.

algorithms.name: CTLO
algorithms.description: Lightweight continuous-time LiDAR odometry with voxelized incremental NDT association.

algorithms.name: DLIO
algorithms.description: Direct LiDAR-inertial odometry with coarse-to-fine continuous-time motion correction.

algorithms.name: FAST-LIO2
algorithms.description: Fast direct LiDAR-inertial odometry with an incremental ikd-Tree map.

algorithms.name: Faster-LIO
algorithms.description: Lightweight tightly coupled LiDAR-inertial odometry using parallel sparse incremental voxels.

algorithms.name: KISS-ICP
algorithms.description: Lightweight point-to-point ICP odometry with adaptive correspondence thresholds.

algorithms.name: LIGO
algorithms.description: Tightly coupled LiDAR-inertial-GNSS odometry for globally referenced localization and mapping.

algorithms.name: PV-LIO
algorithms.description: Probabilistic voxel-map LiDAR-inertial odometry with uncertainty-aware matching and online extrinsic calibration.

algorithms.name: Small Point LIO
algorithms.description: Compact tightly coupled point-wise LiDAR-inertial odometry.

algorithms.name: Small Point SLAM
algorithms.description: High-performance point-wise LiDAR-inertial SLAM with a compact cached voxel map.

algorithms.name: Super-LIO
algorithms.description: Robust LiDAR-inertial odometry with a compact structured map.

algorithms.name: VoxelMap
algorithms.description: Probabilistic adaptive voxel mapping for LiDAR odometry using plane uncertainty.

algorithms.name: VoxelMap (with imu)
algorithms.description: Generalized VoxelMap variant with IMU propagation and point-level LiDAR undistortion.
